workflow.name: untrusted input in run block, env use is fine
workflow.text:
on: issues
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: bad
        run: |
          echo "${{ github.event.issue.title }}"
      - name: good
        env:
          TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
        run: echo "$TITLE"
